author: ChengshuLi
body:
Root source-applicability decision for one pending Popokabaka key; no completion credit.

After independent review of the authenticated v5 custody and the exact-key comparison, root supports and authorizes authoring a NEW narrowly scoped contextual-applicability decision for key [owner14501, y135354, x143074], target gb:COD:ADM2:63176286B47421332346835. This is not an extension or edit of the accepted two-key decision.

Scope is solely the consumed Uige negative ordinal0, original feature16, source gb:AGO:ADM1:26408823B906914650007, geometry SHA25639fcf2d95283675f6c2eecf0466063678a04c7803dc92eae502123879d589e9d, operand SHA256f0f028f05f37279fdd4ee0e9c22ec2b635fb9df4ba8f9e1e4a5e083b4eaf9c83. Bind the complete consumed original operand and current exact source/rule/physical pins; do not substitute a comparator geometry.

The retained exact-key sourceData/full comparisons place this same center outside Uige while the consumed simplified representation includes it. Its actual four-negative signature contains Uige interior with Maquela, Quimbele and Pool empty native kinds. Original mapped-land support is retained. This is a source-relative, representation-sensitive applicability judgment supported by this key's evidence, not analogy alone or a distance threshold. The real Kwango parent overlay is retained as context; it is not one of the original native veto operands. Removing the previously mistaken separate-veto explanation alone would not have sufficed.

Preserve the accepted two-key records unchanged, all17 persistent Uige conflicts, every other original source/contact, and the restricted/unread-source provenance limits. No sovereignty adjudication, international-boundary reassignment, broad source clearance, comparator substitution or full-footprint accuracy claim is made.

Team2 retains end-to-end ownership: construct the new exact-key decision through the existing supported authoring contract; perform the genuinely required stock qualification under that changed decision with truthful CODE/DATA bindings; preserve all prior failed/held observations and decisions; deliver corrected final-map output only if actual qualification succeeds. Reuse unchanged evidence and do not rerun unrelated producers or weaken checkers. Exact public-head independent review and one normal delivery remain mandatory. This decision does not itself remove a live hold, mutate accepted main or award a positive/unresolved outcome.

Current COD remains2977 positives +767 researched-unresolved +161 pending =3905 until separate verified delivery and root acceptance. The independently supported160 researched-unresolved proposals likewise remain conditional pending coherent delivery.
